account.q: Forgot password or can't sign in
account.a: Go to Settings → Account security to reset your password or link your phone. If it still fails, open support chat and send your account ID.

wallet.a: Complete KYC if required. Withdrawals are reviewed by admins. For a specific request, message support with your request ID if you have one.

agency.q: How do I open an agency?
agency.a: Open Agency center → Apply, enter agency name, country, and a valid WhatsApp number. After approval (within 12 hours) you get an invite code to onboard 10 female hosts in 7 days.

rooms.a: Try leaving and rejoining the room. Check microphone permissions. If it persists, describe the issue in support chat with the room name.

report.q: How do I report a user or content?
report.a: Use Report on a profile or post, or open the report flow from the support center. To track past reports, open My reports from the support center.
